summary.name: Isometric Motion Graphics; supplemental, user-requested direction in the Motion Design and Cinematography category.
summary.visualIdentity: Consistent isometric axes, shared scale and light direction. Top and side faces, modest thickness and contact shadows show form; labels stay 2D. Distant objects do not shrink through perspective.
summary.suitableUses: Explicitly favored for clear assembled systems or spaces, such as infrastructure or logistics explainers. Inferred fit: miniature scenes and product diagrams. Poor fit for perspective-driven drama.
summary.limitations: Perspective, camera tilts and diagonal free-form lines break the projection. Parallax alone is not full 3D. Source frames covered only 1–8 seconds, so continuous motion and audio were not verified.
summary.palette: Background is scene-dependent. Unapproved suggestions: #F3EFE6 background, #2C424F foreground, #63968D and #C58662 accents, no gradient. Foreground on background is 9.153:1; accents are decorative only. Exact task colors override.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Objects move along scene axes and settle before connectors reveal. Optional patterns motion-009, -012, -015 and -017 apply only when scene elements support them. Video uses timeline time, not live input.
summary.audio: Unspecified; no audio is mandated. Inferred: restrained accents or ambience at transitions, with voiceover or music only if the topic benefits. Keep speech intelligible and clear of reading holds.
summary.assetRequirements: Assets are optional; no uploads are mandatory. The style needs isometric geometry or flat illustrations with top and side faces, plus local fonts. Other asset requirements are unspecified.
summary.combinations: Style-109 adds axis-aligned diagram connectors between blocks. Style-095 shows flat UI on iso device tops, then cuts to a flat view. Use isometric alone for simple systems.
summary.productionApproach: HyperFrames handles composition, timing, validation and export; Remotion is fallback only for a recorded limitation. Three.js OrthographicCamera renders, GSAP paused timelines drive motion. Verify seeks and composited contrast.
